title: Fix CI runner temporary-directory contexts
summary: Replace invalid job-level runner.temp expressions with runtime RUNNER_TEMP setup for the Windows CI workflows.
reason: GitHub rejected Generated Drift and Deep Audit before creating jobs because runner context is unavailable at job-level env evaluation. The workflows must set temporary directories after a runner is assigned.
behavior_before: Windows CI jobs declared TMP and TEMP from ${{ runner.temp }} at job scope, causing GitHub Actions workflow validation to fail before jobs started.
behavior_after: Each Windows CI job writes TMP and TEMP from RUNNER_TEMP to GITHUB_ENV in a PowerShell step, preserving runner-temp isolation after runner allocation.
manual_validation: GitHub audit-spine guard rejects job-level runner.temp and requires runtime runner-temp setup.
Phase1 generated audit suite and local YAML parsing passed after the workflow repair.
The deep-audit suite passed after the workflow-context repair.
rollback_plan: Revert the runtime GITHUB_ENV setup and restore only a GitHub-supported runner-context placement; rerun GitHub workflow parsing, the audit spine, and phase-one generated checks before publishing.
notes:
